content:
Alyssa: Quick heads-up — I want to get the monorepo vendor + submodule updates in before the upcoming release cutoff. Targeting a dep freeze by EOD Wednesday so we can branch and run the final CI pass. PR I'll open: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/762
Mike: Which lockfile are we locking? top-level poetry.lock or the runtime vendor lock (vendor/lock.json)?
Alyssa: Both ideally. Top-level lock for infra/tools deps and runtime vendor lock for serving runtime. The tricky part is the submodule refs (rlib and kernels) — those can cause CI churn.
Jordan: I can own the runtime vendor bump + submodule refs. Plan: update submodule pointers, run `tools/vendor/regenerate.sh --fast` and push two comms (refs then lock). Will open PR by tomorrow morning.
Sophia: QA note — please don't land any quantization-related kernel changes until we run the model-quality canary. Last time `kv-cache-ttl` flaked after a kernel bump. Can we schedule a canary on dedicated capacity after the vendor update? :eyes:
Kai: Re: merge queue — please avoid large API surface changes in the same window. For any breaking/major bumps, mark the PR with `release/major` label so we can gate rollout. Also ping me if you need backports to release-2.11.
Alyssa: Good call. Jordan — if you can add `release/patch` or `release/major` labels where appropriate, that helps automation.
Jordan: Will do. Also heads-up: there may be a submodule conflict with `thirdparty/llamactl` — @Mike, did you recently touch that?
Mike: I touched the build shim but didn't update the submodule. If Jordan's bump needs it, I can cut a quick PR to update the shim and test locally.
ci-bot: Automerged status: No automerge. CI statuses: lint ⏳, unit-tests ❌ (flaky tests on linux-x86_64), integration ✅. Full logs: https://ci.redwood-inference/internal/8743
Sophia: If unit-tests are flaky, let's try to rerun just the failed matrix first (`ci rerun --jobs=unit-linux`). If it consistently fails after vendor bump, we should pin that test to flaky and file a follow-up.
release-bot: Reminder: release branch cut scheduled at 2026-03-20 18:00 UTC. All dep bumps must be merged and CI green by 2026-03-20 12:00 UTC to allow stabilization window.
Alyssa: OK timeline acknowledged. Owners: Jordan (runtime vendor + submodule refs), Mike (build shim + small backports), Sophia (canary + QA). I'll coordinate the final branch cut and tagging. If anyone expects a large dependency change, shout now so we can move it to post-cutoff. :thumbsup:
